authorship: Independent Codex dataset annotator, before policy executions; exact backend model identifier unavailable
basis: strictly earlier baseline corpus or explicitly fabricated control corpus

reproduction.rationale: A fenced event/log/stack trace is output, not executable source. The parent and child scripts necessary to reproduce the crash are missing.

components.rationale: The failing lifecycle is explicitly utilityProcess.

similarity.rationale: The explicit empty corpus provides no earlier match.
similarity.reporter_link_exclusion: Earlier links already in opening body are ineligible; corpus matching asserts possible symptom overlap, not common root cause.

redirects.rationale: A Node symbol in a stack is not evidence that standalone Node reproduces the issue; no redirect is supported.

attribution_limitations: Single assistant annotation, not maintainer adjudication; independent pre-execution review is separate.
Historical fields and corpus are frozen reconstructed opening evidence; no remote URL, attachment or runtime reproduction was fetched or run.

construction.corpus: explicit per-case override; all rows invented for this control; empty means no candidate
construction.artifact_links: Any reproduction URL is a fictional offline fixture evaluated as a supplied artifact, not a claim that a live remote repository/gist exists.
